notes: ECU-only research session for exact source-table or source-example-inferred five-byte ECM candidates; not a vehicle fitment guarantee. Explicit confirmation required. GuzziOnBoard has synthetic tests only, no hardware verification. No diagnostic sensor tables, DTCs, writes, recovery or simulator. A completed file is not a verified backup.

session.physical_evidence_note: Source-derived attempt for explicitly listed IDs; GuzziOnBoard has synthetic tests only, not hardware verification.

identification.note: Raw five-byte ECM ID candidate only; a source match is not confirmed part identification or programming identity.

memory.write_blocked_reason: No ECU flash writing is implemented for this profile.
memory.hardware_note: Experimental source-derived image read for 60 Honda ID candidates. Eleven IDs are inferred solely from source-named examples; one table ID has an inferred family offset and conflicts with its named example; two source-table entries have no independently checked sample. Example- or model-sized bounds range from 48 KiB to 1 MiB; all starts are assumed, including nonzero MSX offsets. Conflicting or commented source associations are not confirmed identities. 1 MiB reads may take a long time; logs may include image data. Physical K-Line/security/read integration is synthetic-tested only; no verified backup.

flash.note: Maximum bound 1 MiB; sizes and start addresses vary by ID and are inferred from source examples or model descriptions. Three Alex VFR candidates use 128-byte requests; others use 8. Neither read completeness nor live protocol is verified.
